clips.title: The story
paras: Murlocs carry Crystal Kelp Fronds from the ocean to Crystal Lake in Elwynn Forest. William Pestle in Goldshire seeks them for an invisibility liquor.

Crystal Kelp Fronds come from saltwater oceans, so their presence in Elwynn Forest’s fresh water is unusual. Murloc tribes along Crystal Lake’s shores gather and keep the fronds for reasons of their own. Alchemists value their strange power to distort sight. William Pestle in Goldshire uses them as the chief ingredient in an invisibility liquor, meant to help sweethearts slip past watchful family eyes.
